items.note: Prompt does not say the product is a B2B note-taking app.
Prompt does not say the readers are engineering and design leads or that this is for a kickoff.
Prompt does not give the v1 scope: creating a workspace, inviting members by email, and shared notes.
Prompt does not say v1 has only two roles, admin and member.
Prompt does not list what is out of scope for v1: billing changes, SSO, and guest access.
Prompt does not give the success metric: 20% of paid accounts create a workspace within 60 days.
Prompt does not set the length limit of about 2 pages.
Prompt does not say to leave migration of existing shared notes as an open question.
